title: workspaces switcher ghost filter strategy — existence, .graph, and worktree exclusion
summary: In GET /workspaces (routes/meta.js), the candidate path set is now filtered through three predicates before building the response list: (1) fs.existsSync(p) — drops deleted or never-created paths that linger in workspaces.json or graphStore._stores; (2) fs.existsSync(path.join(p, '.graph')) — confirms the path is a real orchestrator workspace, not a transient dir accumulated via ?workspace= reads; (3) fs.statSync(path.join(p, '.git')).isFile() returns false — excludes git worktrees (orch/attempt/* and orch/feature/*) where .git is a gitdir-pointer file rather than a directory. Windows forward-slash/backslash normalization is applied before Set-dedup. Test workspaces must have a .graph subdir to pass the filter; the test was updated accordingly and extended with two new cases: ghost path dropped (G) and removed-dir disappears (H). 29/29 assertions pass.
